description: Studie Railspect 2019 is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. De studie Railspect werd gemaakt door GfK na aanvraag van Infrabel en gebeurde bij 1.000 Belgen, die in de buurt van een overweg wonen en/of die af en toe met de trein reizen. Coverage: Belgium. The portal files it under Veiligheid. Its keywords are Veiligheid, Overweg, Spoorlopers. The portal shows 2022-07-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
